title: ServerSignedAuthClaims
description: Canonical body serialised via OSPP Canonical Form (spec/06-security.md §4.8) and base64-encoded into the `signedAuthorization.data` field of a ServerSignedAuth message for ECDSA P-256 signing. Per profiles/offline/ble-handshake.md §4.2.1. 12 required claims — no optional fields. `durationSeconds` (finding N3) is the authorized duration: the station refuses a StartServiceRequest above it and never reduces the request (profiles/offline/ble-session.md §1); `creditsAuthorized` is the issue-time pre-debit and the most the session may be charged: the server recomputes the cost per the Billing Authority (04-flows §6) and settles it as a refund-only true-up that never exceeds `creditsAuthorized` while the pre-debit stands, and, for a receipt that arrives after the expiry refunded the pre-debit, as one debit with no prior debit, up to the same cap (reconciliation §6.7, §8, §8.1, §8.2). Both are signed so the station enforces a server-authorized duration it can cryptographically trust, not an app-supplied request. The digest signed by the server's private key is SHA-256 over the canonical bytes directly (NOT over the base64 form).

authId.description: Server-side unique identifier for this authorisation. Mirrors the `passId` / `offlineTxId` convention (lowercase prefix, lowercase hex).

sub.description: User subject identifier the authorisation is issued to.

deviceId.description: Mobile device the authorisation was issued to, as the server recorded it from the authenticated app. The station does not compare it with anything: the Hello carries no device identifier, and check #4 of ble-handshake.md §4.2.2 is withdrawn. It is signed into the receipt's deviceId, and reconciliation compares the two (reconciliation.md §6.7).

sessionId.description: Session this authorisation activates. The station MUST cross-check against the outer envelope's `sessionId` (§4.2.2 check #5).

stationId.description: Station this authorisation is valid for. The station MUST cross-check against its own provisioned `stationId` (§4.2.2 check #3) — prevents cross-station replay.

durationSeconds.description: Authorized service duration in seconds (finding N3). The station MUST refuse a requestedDurationSeconds above this signed value with 3010 MAX_DURATION_EXCEEDED, and MUST NOT reduce the request to it (profiles/offline/ble-session.md §1). Signed so the station enforces a server-authorized bound, not an app-supplied request.

creditsAuthorized.description: Authorized credit budget for this session (finding N3) — the issue-time pre-debit, and the most the session may be charged: settlement recomputes the cost per the Billing Authority (04-flows §6) and is a refund-only true-up that never exceeds it while the pre-debit stands, or, for a receipt that arrives after the expiry refunded the pre-debit, one debit up to it with no prior debit (reconciliation §6.7, §8, §8.1, §8.2). Signed.

appNonce.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte cryptographically random nonce, equal to the `appNonce` the app writes in the upcoming `Hello` message. The server MUST read this from the `POST /sessions/offline-auth` request body. The station MUST cross-check against `Hello.appNonce` (§4.2.2 check #2) — primary, clock-independent anti-replay defence.

issuedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this authorisation was signed.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which this authorisation MUST NOT be accepted. MUST be no later than five minutes after `issuedAt`. Secondary clock-skew bound; `appNonce` (§4.2.2 check #2) is the primary anti-replay defence.
